thought.text: Redis responds PONG. Postgres is still initializing on first boot. Let me wait for it to be healthy.

reasoning_content:
Both containers are up. Redis responds PONG. Postgres was "health: starting" and pg_isready returned no response (still initializing, first boot). Let me wait for postgres to be healthy.

The compose `ps` output is very noisy due to env var warnings. I'll set the needed env vars to reduce noise. Let me wait for postgres readiness.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export SVA_ENABLE_MONITORING=false POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sva_local_dev_password APP_DB_USER=sva_app APP_DB_PASSWORD=sva_app_local_dev_password REDIS_PASSWORD=sva-secure-password-2026 WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_PASSWORD=sva_waste_provisioner_local_dev
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if docker exec sva-studio-postgres pg_isready -U sva -d sva_studio >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "postgres ready after ${i} tries"; break; fi
  sleep 2
done
docker exec sva-studio-postgres pg_isready -U sva -d sva_studio 2>&1; echo "pg exit: $?"
